audio_urls.description: Audio reference URLs. Maximum 10 audios (MP3/WAV, each 2–30 seconds and up to 15 MB); total audio reference duration must not exceed 30 seconds. Audio-only references are allowed.

prompt.description: the text prompt describing the video to generate

duration.description: Duration of the generated video in seconds (4-15). In `first_last_frames` mode with video references, the output length may match the reference.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. Use auto in first-last-frames mode to auto detect image ar.

video_urls.description: Reference video URLs for `omni_reference` mode. Each item can be a public URL or an `asset://<asset_id>` reference (same rules as `image_urls`).

mode.description:
Generation mode. Required.
- `text_to_video`: Pure text-to-video, no references needed.
- `first_last_frames`: Use 1-2 images as first/last frame references. aspect_ratio is ignored in this mode.
- `omni_reference`: Use 1-12 mixed references (images, videos, audio) for flexible multi-modal generation.

audio_urls.description: Audio reference URLs (`mp3`, `wav`, ≤ 15 s total). Each item can be a public URL or an `asset://<asset_id>` reference (same rules as `image_urls`).

resolution.description: Resolution of the generated video.

auto_upload_assets.description: When `true`, every non-`asset://` URL in `image_urls` / `video_urls` / `audio_urls` is uploaded to your Private Asset Library as an **ephemeral** asset before the task runs and is automatically cleaned up after the retention window. Only accepted on `-less-restriction` task types.

asset_retention_hours.description: Used together with `auto_upload_assets`: how long the uploaded ephemeral assets stay alive after the task completes. Useful when you want to chain follow-up tasks against the same references. Ignored when `auto_upload_assets` is `false`.

text.description: the text to be synthesized. Up to 2048 characters (unicode-aware).

audio_url.description: publicly accessible reference audio URL, ≤30 s, ≤10 MB

image_url.description: publicly accessible reference image URL, ≤10 MB

The parameter upscales the selected image.
Light/beta are available for V4 model UPSCALED tasks only; 2x/4x for V5 model UPSCALED tasks only; subtle/creative for V6 UPSCALED tasks models only.

Image index to do the variation - valid values can be 1, 2, 3, 4, high_variation, & low_variation.
High_variation and low_variation are only valid for both V5.2 and V6 tasks (high_variation means vary_strong, low_variation stands for vary_subtle; high_variation and low_variation are meant to use upon upscaled(u1/u2/u3/u4) task, not original imagine/blend task
